Key data rows for process steps and NG results are omitted from evidence.
Rows 37 and 49 are cited but not shown in provided context.
correctionPlan: Set changed factor to MC bonding frame plus ass'y SP process improvement for PHI.
Use before improve/Normal as baseline and after improve/Test MC as changed condition.
Cite process comparison rows 7-14 and result data rows 38-43 and 50-54.
Separate outcomes into process WK change, vision frame SP NG, and final SPK visual NG under one review case.
Preserve date, line E2-4B, type check, lot, and Sub 3 as subgroup context.
